items.title: Sensex, Nifty snap 2-week rally as oil shock, FII selling weigh on D-Street
items.description: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) remained net sellers for the ninth consecutive week, offloading equities worth Rs 2,697.37 crore, although the selling eased.

items.title: Trade Repair: The smart way to minimise loss in a losing position: Shubham Agarwal
items.description: If price movement is hurting a long call, selling a call near the upper edge of the new range may collect premium and cushion the loss.

items.title: Wall Street closes lower to end rocky week
items.description: The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 652.82 points, or 1.23%, to 52,215.16; the S&P 500 lost 39.75 points, or 0.52%, to 7,623.68 and the Nasdaq Composite lost 53.52 points, or 0.21%, to 25,955.34.

items.title: Dr Reddy’s on track to restart semaglutide rollout; Canada to drive initial demand
items.description: “We will launch in November and the numbers for both Q3 and Q4 will be 6 to 7 million units across 10 markets,” CEO Erez Israeli said, adding that Canada will account for the majority of those volumes.

items.title: Invesco Mutual Fund picks up 3.5% stake in Sahajanand Medical; Yali Capital exits Tonbo Imaging India
items.description: Trading activity was significant in newly listed Tonbo Imaging India, a manufacturer of defence electronics equipment. The stock made a blockbuster debut on Friday, surging 62 percent to close at Rs 1,133.80 against its issue price of Rs 700 per share.

items.title: 4 Common Mutual Fund Mistakes That Can Hurt Your Returns | MC Explains
items.description:
Are you making these common mutual fund mistakes without even realising it?

In this episode of MC Explains, brought to you by Moneycontrol.com and Invesco Mutual Fund, we break down four common mistakes that can undermine your long-term investment journey — and explain how to avoid them.

From chasing the latest investment trends to stopping your SIPs during market corrections, seemingly small decisions can affect how you build and manage your mutual fund portfolio over time.

items.title: Kilitch Drugs to sell Ethiopia unit for $14 million, eyes GLP-1 and India expansion
items.description: "Our focus is on building the next phase of Kilitch Drugs' growth by strengthening our manufacturing capabilities and expanding our presence in high-potential pharmaceutical segments," said Bhavin Mehta, Whole-Time Director of Kilitch Drugs (India) Limited.
